title: evorule law_set v1.0 (finalized)
description: Law-set (law_set) dataset contract: an array of always-true law entries (id/formula/symbols/si_units/max_version_depth/monotone_form required; tier=light|full; domains multi-domain vector with cross_refs explicit cross-domain declaration edges; entry-level additionalProperties=false strict shape, single-file self-contained with no cross-file $ref). Relocated on 2026-11-12 from the evorule-server core/law_schema embedded copy to this repository as SSOT (governance relocation: instance-validation semantics field-identical to the server embedded copy, only constitution header fields added); the server side has since exited the mirror chain (criticality domain migrated out), and copy consistency is now guarded by the mirror-drift-check job in the evorule-criticality repository.

See ../../LEGAL_NOTES.md and ../../docs/adr/scope-split-ip-model.md

domains.description: multi-domain membership (domain vector generalizes the single-domain form; the default equals the unchanged single-domain semantics of the domain field)

target.description: referenced law id (within the same set)

domain.description: landing domain of the reference edge (cross-domain declaration)

cross_refs.description: explicit declaration of cross-domain reference edges (D2=A: declared at registration, auto-discovery forbidden)

max_version_depth.description: version-chain height h_p (finiteness declaration): the maximum depth of this law's version chain, required and >= 1

monotone_form.description: monotone-form declaration: the value must be true (non-monotone law forms are rejected and must be rewritten with a time anchor before resubmission)

time_anchor.description: time-anchored rewrite declaration anchor (optional; must be non-empty when the formula hits negation-class constructs)
